column1: # Generated by check_dead_exports.sh, which also gates it.  Every row is
# an exported symbol that no OTHER production translation unit
# references.  References from anything under tests/ do not count: a
# test calling a function directly is exactly what hid this class of
# defect, so counting tests would defeat the gate.
# THIS LIST IS EXPECTED TO SHRINK AND MUST NEVER GROW.  Wiring a dead
# procedure into the daemon makes its row fail as "allowlisted symbol is
# now referenced"; that failure is the intended signal, not an obstacle.
# Resolve it by deleting the row, or regenerate the whole file:
# Regeneration preserves the category and note of every symbol already
# listed, so review work is never lost.
# class -- how the census sees the symbol
#   unreferenced  no production unit names it: dead code.
#   file-local    named only inside its own defining unit; it is
# category -- whether the row is a PROBLEM
#   client-role-api      Not a problem.  Client-model entry point for a
#                        role this product does not implement; meshd
#                        only serves these models.  Kept as API.
#   public-library-api   Not a problem.  Exported through the installed
#                        ble.h and libble.3; consumers are out of tree.
#   simulator-api        Not a problem.  mesh_sim harness surface,
#                        driven by tests and tools, not by meshd.
#   dead-mandatory       A PROBLEM.  An implemented mesh procedure with
#                        no production caller: it executes in no shipped
#                        code path however green its unit tests are.
#                        Fix it by wiring it up, not by listing it.
#   unreviewed           PRESUMED A PROBLEM.  Seeded by the census and
#                        not yet triaged.  Reclassify, with a note, as
# 553 rows: client-role-api 134, dead-mandatory 185, public-library-api 83, simulator-api 24, unreviewed 127
